subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What provider-reported OpenRouter cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose, and which runtime/session/channel surfaces should consume it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix affects public runtime/session semantics, provider-cost precedence, persistence, plugin/channel consumption, and user-facing wording, so automation should not choose the contract alone.

options.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
options.body: Expose provider-reported OpenRouter cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, and raw details, while keeping local estimates as fallback display data.

options.title: Keep exact cost outside core
options.body: Leave core runtime/status surfaces on estimated cost fields and route exact OpenRouter accounting to a plugin or external ledger surface.

options.title: Fold into broader usage ledger
options.body: Defer this issue until the native per-call usage ledger or resolved-model observability work defines a shared completed-call accounting contract.

recommendation.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
recommendation.body: Expose provider-reported OpenRouter cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, and raw details, while keeping local estimates as fallback display data.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on OpenRouter billed-cost reconciliation, usage/session persistence, and prior contract review for this issue family.
